question: Hello, Oda Sensei! My birthday is October 11. There were no characters on my birthday so far, so I came up with an idea! 10/11 could be ichi (1) ban oo (0) kii wan-wan (1 1 ), meaning "the biggest doggy"! That could be the birthday for Duke Inuarashi, Ruler of Day of the Mokomo Dukedom!!
answer: What?! You want to decide it just like that?! Okay.
name: Masaju
